county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.

top_violation_types.title: Meal preparation, except when 12 or fewer children are in care (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection a caregiver was observed preparing meals in the kitchen well supervising children.

top_violation_types.title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon CCR's arrival the operation was using a reduced nap time ratio with only 1 caregiver present in the building and more than 13 children.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Anchoring devices Below Level of Playing Surface (26 TAC §746.4601(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There are 2 playgrounds that do not meet minimum standards for surface levels.  30 days will be given in order to have both playgrounds at adequate surface levels for children.

top_violation_types.title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Caregivers were sending and receiving personal text messages while caring for children.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A Caregiver admitted to smoking a vape cigarette in the breakroom of the facility   while children were present.
